verdict.rationale: Appwrite exposes delete APIs for files/storage and database rows, and self-hosting gives 'full control over data location', which lets an AI-native user implement their own retention/deletion logic. However there's no documented retention-policy engine, TTL/auto-expiry settings, account/data-deletion workflow, or GDPR/right-to-be-forgotten tooling in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit data retention policy controls, automated expiry/TTL settings, documented user/account deletion workflow, compliance-oriented deletion guarantees.
